Put here:

- neogeo.zip   the Neo Geo BIOS, as in the MAME / FBNeo romsets

- your games, one .neo file each.
  .neo is the single-file format created by TerraOnion for the NeoSD
  cartridge: it holds all the ROMs of a game plus a header with its name,
  year and number. Files made for the NeoSD work as they are.
  MAME / FBNeo zip romsets are not read directly: convert them to .neo
  with TerraOnion's free NeoBuilder tool.

The file names do not matter: the game list shows the names stored inside
the .neo files. With only one game here, neo-pi starts it straight away.

BIOS and games are not included with neo-pi.
